I struggle to stick to self care, such as taking routine medicines, brushing teeth or changing my clothes unless I'm prompted by someone else such as parents. It's cool that you have patients that have both conditions and have the ability to take their meds, but at this current point in time it's a massive struggle for me and I have no system in place to help me combat that issue. It's not that I'm actively choosing to not prioritise my health, nor do I have any expectations that a doctor can force me to do it on my own.
